literature_notes: All three ledger lines describe FLAG tags at the N-terminus (L1: 3×FLAG prepended to residue 1; L2: FLAG prepended to residue 1) or C-terminus (L3: FLAG appended after residue 694) of full-length CNGA3. The authoritative topology places the N-terminus (residues 1–170) and C-terminus (residues 397–694) entirely in the intracellular compartment. Neither terminus is extracellular, so none of these insertions qualifies as an extracellular surface tag site. The only extracellular spans are ECL1 (residues 189–199, 11 aa) and ECL2 (residues 325–378, 54 aa), but no ledger line reports any insertion in either loop. Because the ledger provides no evidence of a tolerated insertion on the extracellular face, sites = [].
